name: drawing_number_on_the_document
why: The term of comparison: a property is written on the document and read back. It is the case that says the operation works, and it is needed because without it a refusal on a broken case would not tell a check that works from one that refuses everything.
_why_also_the_state: The operation re-reads by itself and answers the value: if the case looked only at that, an operation that keeps the value in a variable and does not touch the file would pass. The state of the document is read by another part of the code, and reads from the real document.

expect.why: the value must be read from the document, not from the answer of the operation that wrote it
writing a property does not touch the geometry: if the volume changes, the operation is doing something else
THE SECOND WRITE REPLACES. With «only if new» SOLIDWORKS would leave «A» and answer the same: a revision that does not change with nobody giving an error.
